key_idea: Draw the line of singers from first to last.
steps: 3 singers come after her: places 5, 6 and 7.
The last singer comes after them, in place 8.
So there are 8 singers in all.

choice_feedback.A: With 5 singers, nobody could be between Nora and the last singer.
choice_feedback.B: With 6 singers, only 1 singer would be between Nora and the last singer.
choice_feedback.C: With 7 singers, only 2 singers would be between Nora and the last singer.
choice_feedback.E: With 9 singers, 4 singers would be between Nora and the last singer.
